prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1103
Claimant:
Jeanne Robertson
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
September 22, 2024
Claim received by phone from the policyholder's driver reporting a side impact at a signalized intersection. The
claimant states they were struck on the driver's side by a vehicle entering from the cross street, and confirmed that
the driver is named on the policy.
October 22, 2024
Reviewed the policy and confirmed coverage was in froce at the time of loss, with no sign of any issue predating the
coverage start. Requested the police report, photos from the scene, and statements from the other driver and a
witness.
December 2, 2024
Spoke with the claimant, who is not represented by an attorney, and took a recorded statement. The account
matched the first report in every detail. The claimant reports a back strain from the impact and says they sought care
the following day.
December 13, 2024
Received scene photos and the witness statement. Both support the claimant's description of the collision and the
other driver has confirmed the sequence of events. Vehicle damage is concentrated along the driver's side and
appears largely consistent with the described impact.
December 16, 2024
Obtained medical records showing the reported injury is consistent with the type and force of a side impact.
Treatment followed a typical course and tapered as the claimant improved. Records show no prior complaints
involving the same area of the back.
December 31, 2024
Reviewed the vehicle inspection. No prior damage to the vehicle is known from the prior claims history. The claimant
could not say with certainty which seat position they occupied at the moment of impact, though this does not appear
to change the overall picture of the loss.
January 2, 2025
Reviewed all materials. Injury, vehicle damage, witness accounts, and scene evidence fit together, and the claimant's
account has stayed consistent throughout. File moved to the next stage for evaluation of the bodily injury and
property damage components.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
